scope: Deterministically classify concurrency eligibility for already-valid Phase 2D plan tasks. This packet does not dispatch, schedule, execute, retry, cache, cancel, resume, compile context, call specialists, perform blind evaluation or admit canonical manuscript changes.
laws: Concurrency eligibility is permission for a later scheduler to consider simultaneous execution; it is never execution itself.
Correctness, authority, isolation and evidence requirements outrank speed.
Only tasks in the same Phase 2D topological layer may be considered together; dependency-related tasks are never parallelized.
Required and optional dependency edges both constrain concurrency because Phase 2D topology treats both as ordering edges.
A task classified SERIAL_ONLY remains serial even when topologically independent.
A task classified ISOLATION_GATED remains ineligible until its required qualified isolation seam exists and is explicitly evidenced.
DECLARED_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY, AUTHORITY_WAIT and BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF are never specialist concurrency candidates.
No concurrency decision can widen a capability authority domain or make a non-callable capability callable.
No concurrency decision may grant canonical manuscript-write authority to Prose, evaluator, Research, Story Bible, continuity or the orchestrator.
Provider availability, rate limits, resource limits and actual worker concurrency remain Phase 6 scheduler concerns.
A concurrency group must contain at least two independently eligible tasks; singletons are classified but not emitted as parallel groups.
Derived eligibility output is deterministic and ordered by topological layer then exact task ID.
Changed plan digest or workflow/source identity requires a newly derived concurrency decision; prior decisions are stale.

isolation_gate.rule: Do not infer true blind/fresh-context isolation from hosted fixtures or shared chat context. Phase 3E must create and qualify the blind-package isolation seam before these capabilities may be promoted to parallel eligibility where isolation is required.
